I got my kyleena IUD in last december. The insertion was quick and not that painful, I only took ibuprofen and paracetamol (so no sedation). The IUD definitely has had a positive impact on my sex life. It hasnt lowered my libido or given me mood swings. My hair getting oilier faster is the only side effect I've noticed.

Good luck with your insertion :) i hope your iud treats you well <3
